name: @speedora/llm-client
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): a thin wrapper around OpenAI's structured (json_schema, strict) chat-completion call, extracted from its 4th independent duplication across clip-scoring/subtitle-translate/seo-copy/clip-query-parser (see docs/ai/intelligence-v4.md ADR D3). No DB/queue access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md. The OpenAI client is injected via deps, never constructed from process.env in here. Consumed by new AI Intelligence v4 LLM-reasoning modules (starting with packages/hook-prediction) - existing call sites are not migrated.
